title: OPS — orchestrator: increase insight+script stage timeouts to 600s
summary: Increased STAGE_TIMEOUTS for '4-insight' and '5-script' from 300s to 600s in scs001-orchestrator/index.ts. qwen3:14b on Mac Mini M4 needs more than 5min to generate insights and scripts for 11+ clips, causing pipeline to produce 0 scripts.
root_cause: Pipeline latest.json shows scripts_produced:0 and two Stage timeout after 300s errors. Stages 4+5 are LLM-heavy and need more than 5min on local hardware.
fix: Bump insight and script stage timeouts from 300_000 to 600_000.
